categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production and sales of high-performance engineering plastic products and assemblies. The company offers comprehensive solutions including material selection, formulation design, and product design for customers. Main product categories include: sealing components and assemblies, insulating components and assemblies, functional structural components, corrosion-resistant pipes, granules, and PTFE films. These products are widely applied in general machinery manufacturing (valves, compressors), communications equipment, high-speed rail and rail transit equipment, automotive manufacturing, instruments and meters, medical devices, semiconductor equipment, environmental protection equipment, and wind power equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered modification formulations for multiple engineering plastics including PTFE, PEEK, and modified PA through independent R&D. Core technologies include: (1) Material modification and compounding techniques for various engineering plastics; (2) Multiple processing methods including molding, sintering, injection molding, extrusion, and precision machining; (3) Advanced techniques such as isostatic molding and PTFE plate welding; (4) Automated continuous molding processes and self-developed equipment; (5) Comprehensive testing capabilities with over 70 material and product testing items. The company operates a provincial engineering technology research center with advanced laboratory facilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves high-end customers in multiple industries: general machinery manufacturing (valve and compressor manufacturers), communications equipment manufacturers, high-speed rail and rail transit equipment manufacturers, automotive manufacturers, instrument and meter manufacturers, medical device manufacturers, semiconductor equipment manufacturers, environmental protection equipment manufacturers, and wind power equipment manufacturers. The company has established long-term stable partnerships with leading global and domestic high-end equipment manufacturers. Main customer types are concentrated in industrial control, valve manufacturing, and compressor production sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries including Nanjing Kente New Materials Co., Ltd., Nanjing Runte New Materials Co., Ltd., Tianjin Fluorine Membrane New Materials Co., Ltd., and 3S PLASTICS, LLC in the United States. Sales markets span mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, the United States, and the European Union. The company maintains sales offices and technical support in major markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (PTFE, PEEK, PA, and other engineering plastics) from suppliers, processes them through various manufacturing techniques, and sells finished high-performance engineering plastic products and assemblies directly to end-use manufacturers in various industries. The company also provides some raw materials and granules to other processors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Accelerating implementation of capital projects to increase production capacity and shorten delivery times; (2) Expanding product categories and application fields, particularly in military, medical devices, semiconductors, environmental protection, and wind power sectors; (3) Increasing independent innovation efforts in high-performance engineering plastic technology and processing techniques; (4) Pursuing import substitution through high-quality, cost-competitive products; (5) Exploring strategic cooperation opportunities to enrich product structure. Current R&D projects focus on PTFE medical tube development and shaft seal/composite seal materials.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of high-performance engineering plastic products and assemblies to industrial customers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales, or upon customs clearance for export sales. The company operates on a make-to-order basis supplemented by inventory production for regular customers. Revenue streams include: sealing components and assemblies (55.51% of 2023 revenue), PTFE films (17.50%), functional structural components (8.87%), corrosion-resistant pipes (4.99%), insulating components (4.92%), granules (6.26%), and other products (1.95%).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented industry with many small and medium-sized enterprises. The company positions itself as a high-end supplier competing primarily on technology, quality, and service rather than price. It has achieved competitive parity with European, American, and Japanese engineering plastic manufacturers. The company holds a strong market position in valve-specific engineering plastic products domestically and internationally. As one of the earliest entrants in China's high-performance engineering plastic products industry, the company has established significant competitive advantages through technical expertise, quality control, and long-term customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 389.84 million (up 4.73% from 2022's RMB 372.25 million) and net profit of RMB 75.30 million (up 2.72% from 2022's RMB 73.31 million). Total assets reached RMB 533.30 million at year-end 2023 (up 12.34% from RMB 474.72 million). The company demonstrates steady growth with improving profitability. It went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange's ChiNext board in February 2024, issuing 21.03 million shares. The company maintains strong cash generation with operating cash flow of RMB 44.07 million in 2023.
